==Description==
{{Color|{{FULLPAGENAME}}|0}} is a gear set designed by Rhodes Island.
Preferred by their medics' and used combatants that wears them and stuff pockets of medical supplies in them<ref>[[LYNX Cuirass]]: Description</ref>, this gear helps in emergency medical care with tools for various conditions. The tools include;
* Shield sealants<ref>[[LYNX Aegis Injector]]: Description</ref>
* Data calibrator & connector<ref>[[LYNX Connector]]: Description</ref>
* [[Blight]] sensitive detector<ref>[[LYNX Slab]]: Description</ref>
Some gear include features that comes from their tradition of furnishing their PPE with [[Oripathy]] monitoring modules,<ref>[[LYNX Gauntlets]]: Description</ref> and other gears come with heavier versions than what the medics' team preferred.<ref>[[LYNX Heavy Armor]]: Description</ref>
